Name: Lois
Summary: Lois was Timothy's grandmother, whose unfeigned faith Paul says dwelt first in her, then in Eunice, and then in Timothy.
KeyStory: Lois was Timothy's grandmother, whose unfeigned faith Paul says dwelt first in her, then in Eunice, and then in Timothy.
LifeLesson: Faith passed from grandmother to mother to child is a chain of grace across generations.
